native_geometry: unchanged pinned predicates; main retains native memo, interner, circuit state, error builders and execution/publication order

reservation.worker_lanes: at most three already-ready idle workers created by the exact default pool factory
reservation.main_lane: original synchronous native frame computes one pure task group
upfront_declines: unready, active, queued, candidate-owned or reserved workers
unsupported caller-modified transport or ledger descriptors
reservation.protocol_after_admission: every infrastructure, invariant or protocol error fails the pool, retires/terminates all workers, and propagates the original failure
reservation.deadline_role: infrastructure deadline only; original routing solver effort and caps unchanged
reservation.completion: dedicated owned transferred MessagePort and one SAB terminal word; no ordinary onmessage acknowledgement or event-loop wait
reservation.cleanup: all ports closed and no reservation remains before subsequent ordinary dispatch

schema.native_algorithm_exception: returned as a pure fact and re-executed on main at the original native miss site to preserve native error identity and ordering

provenance.executor: module-private WeakSet brand bound to exact default pool, book and transport
provenance.workers: every actual pool and book slot checked against private pool-created Worker identities; cold-book custom URL injection cannot mint a native executor
provenance.observers: descriptor-only upfront checks; no callback, Proxy or getter is promoted to native execution
provenance.inactive_pool: captured Set/array operations and original ledger object/row identities; caller-replaced ledger getters withdraw optional tracking before ordinary native work

unchanged: native cache warmness and ordered consumption
actual_worker_native_capture_oracle.ordinary_dispatch_after_facts: four additional warmup tasks complete with original task ownership and counters

covers: global protocol failures including unused rows
